notes.title: Celebrating 14 years of gore and guts PLUS 20 million Slayers in Dead Island 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24978319/080bf1e43f9ba2fbaa205d74e2bc142a82a22810.png[/img]

[h3]It's been 14 years since Dead Island first splattered onto the scene, stranding players in the blood-soaked paradise of Banoi. [/h3]
Since then, the zompocalypse has crawled from tropical shores to the sun-drenched chaos of HELL-A in Dead Island 2, where [b]over 20 million Slayers[/b] have left nothing but carnage behind.

[b]This isn’t the final cut[/b] though. Dambuster Studios are already carving out what comes next.
For now, the details stay under wraps, [b]the outbreak is far from over[/b]...

[b][u]Play Dead Island 2 NOW.[/u][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/934700/Dead_Island_2/

notes.title: Dead Island 2 is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
Dead Island 2 has landed on Steam, unleashing chaos in the fiery streets of HELL-A. It's time to carve your path through the apocalypse, hacking and slashing your way to survival in this burning city. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/934700/Dead_Island_2/

To make your trip to HELL-A even more pleasant, we are slashing the prices too:  Dead Island 2 comes with a killer 50% discount. So don’t miss this awesome opportunity! 

If your comrades are battling zombies on the Epic Games Store, fear not - crossplay on PC ensures no survivor gets left behind. Rally your crew and let them know it's time to face the apocalypse TOGETHER! 

[h3]But hold onto your machetes, there's more excitement coming your way... [/h3]

We’re launching multiple rewards on PROS. From now on you will be able to get your hands on the exclusive From Dusk character skins, along with weapons like Fenrir’s Howl, Trickster’s Knife and Jacob's Bo Staff! Oh, and did we mention the brand-new badass "Rise and Shine" Crowbar? It's yours for the taking. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878915/fe7f89711e4a7edfa51c6aedaac4b2d4ee7279cb.png[/img]

[h3]Don’t know what PROS is and how to join it? We have prepared a manual just for you: [/h3]
[url=https://deadisland.com/PROSlinking ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878915/50a8d4fcf897229a3110814ecaf839ae2c1e635c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Steam Deck [/h2]

Wait, there's MORE! Dead Island 2 is not only playable on Steam, but also compatible with Steam Deck, so you’ll be able to smoothly chop zombies, even on the go.  

Experiencing problems? Follow our FAQ to get Dead Island 2 running smoothly on your Steam Deck: 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/934700/discussions/0/4368004468484074346/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878915/8d8cdf3d49c72e73ddcdffaef76ff8642e357550.png[/img][/url]

[i][h5]What are you waiting for, Slayers? The apocalypse is calling and it's time to answer. Grab your weapons, gather your squad and let's show those zombies who's BOSS!  [/h5][/i]

[h3]If you aren’t already, be sure to follow us for updates and news about Dead Island 2 on:[/h3]

[url=https://twitter.com/deepsilver]🔹 Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/deepsilver]🔹 Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/deepsilver]🔹 Facebook[/url]

[i][h3]See you in HELL-A [/h3][/i]

notes.title: Patch Now Live
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24978377/524ad9c95329f59d762f88a70ea4f31ec2807622.png[/img]

We have released a new patch for both Dead Island and Riptide Definitive Editions. This patch fixes missing weapon blueprints, optimises placement of collectible items, improves network stability and more.

Included in this patch...

[list]
[*]Added missing mods/weapons/blueprints (BBQ, Exploding Meat, Ripper)
[*]Proper loot and updated item placement for important items (like collectibles)
[*]Removed the metallic blood effect
[*]Resolved audio issue with sound stuttering and adjusted level of co-op player sounds
[*]Co-op network stability improved
[*]Ferry mission crash bug fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Last days to upgrade to the Definitive Edition at a discount
notes.content:
The discount on the Definitive Editions for owners of Dead Island and Dead Island Riptide will retire on Thursday, June 23, at 10 AM Pacific Time (that’s 6 PM BST in the UK, 7 PM CEST in Europe).

After the upgrade discount retires, any future discounts will still work but won’t be affected by whether or not you own the original games.

In the meantime, we are working with the developer on various fixes for an upcoming patch.

notes.title: Now on Linux & SteamOS!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Dead Island Definitive Edition and Dead Island: Riptide Definitive Edition now support Linux & SteamOS!

And don't forget: As a Steam owner of either the original Dead Island, Dead Island Riptide, or both titles, you’ll also automatically receive a loyalty discount of up to 85% off the respective Definitive Edition of the game(s) you own, as well as a discount on the Definitive Collection bundle based on whether you own one or both. 

Happy hunting!
